1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening __exposes a dielectric material or core layer beneath a solder mask layer__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure has a thickness greater than 50 micrometers__.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening __and extends into the core layer or dielectric material__.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening __and is in direct contact with the core layer or dielectric material__.

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __by a distance of at least 100 micrometers__.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __to expose an underlying substrate structure__.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer __such that the stiffening microstructure is in direct contact with the core layer__.

7. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid __having a thickness greater than 100 micrometers and a contact area with the packaging structure greater than 50 square millimeters__.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the heat transfer medium is disposed in a gap between the lid and the integrated circuit chip__.

10. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure __and the stiffening microstructure provides structural support to the ground reference plane layer__.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening exposes a dielectric material or core layer beneath a solder mask layer__; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure has a thickness greater than 50 micrometers__.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening __and is in direct contact with the core layer or dielectric material__.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __by a distance of at least 100 micrometers__.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __to expose an underlying substrate structure__.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer __such that the stiffening microstructure is in direct contact with the core layer__.

19. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is one of a ring or a lid.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with ground reference plane layer __and provides structural support to the ground reference plane layer__.
